situations.name: idle
situations.why: Nothing is running, so Run is offered for real and Stop is refused.

situations.name: preview
situations.why: A browser preview cannot call a model, so Run offers a dry run instead.

situations.name: running
situations.why: A pipeline run is in flight, so Run is refused and Stop offers pipeline.stop.

situations.name: reporting
situations.why: The debug agent is on a turn, so Stop offers report.stop.

situations.name: agent-turn
situations.why: An agent turn is in flight, which the header cannot stop, so Run and Stop are both refused.

situations.name: counts
situations.why: Validation found errors and warnings, art is waiting and notifications are unread, so the three popup openers carry counts and the problem button is drawn.

situations.name: warnings
situations.why: Only warnings were found, so the problem button counts those.

situations.name: history
situations.why: A change was made and one was undone, so both arrows are offered naming what each moves.

situations.name: empty
situations.why: Nothing has happened yet, so Clear is refused and only the header’s controls are drawn.

situations.name: rows
situations.why: Three rows are drawn: two offer follow and ×, and the one ×’d in this popup offers Undo instead.

situations.name: paged
situations.why: The log runs past one page, so the button that draws the next page is offered.

situations.name: filtering
situations.why: The category filter is up with two categories on, so each category’s tick and Clear filters are drawn beside the list.

situations.name: empty
situations.why: Nothing needs approval, so no row is drawn.

situations.name: waiting
situations.why: Three pictures wait: a plate, a portrait blocked upstream, and a shot whose slot is already settled; each row opens its picture.

situations.name: clean
situations.why: Nothing is wrong with the project, so no row is drawn.

situations.name: problems
situations.why: Of three diagnostics only the one about a listed scene is a row; it opens Script elsewhere, since only the tree is up.

situations.name: problems-script-up
situations.why: Script is up, so the scene row opens it here.

situations.name: nothing
situations.why: No asset is on screen, so the bar’s buttons other than reload are refused and nothing else is drawn.

situations.name: back
situations.why: The pane was retargeted by a prerequisite row, so DRAWN FROM offers ← back to the picture it came from.

situations.name: plate
situations.why: An accepted plate offers Un-approve, Replace on its slot, the notes and seed boxes of its rung, and a row per picture it was drawn from, greyed where the manifest has no such bytes.

situations.name: plate-unaccepted
situations.why: A plate not yet accepted offers Accept.

situations.name: portrait-unapproved
situations.why: A portrait is approved through the gate, so Accept becomes gate.approve and Replace is refused.

situations.name: concept
situations.why: A concept cannot be accepted, but can be promoted to a plate and redrawn from its own prompt.

situations.name: failed
situations.why: The picture’s task gave up, so the failure band offers its task and a conversation about it.

situations.name: superseded
situations.why: A later render holds the slot, so Accept becomes asset.restore and Replace is refused.

situations.name: stale
situations.why: The prompt has moved on since these bytes, so Regenerate offers a pipeline run instead of a requeue.

situations.name: upload
situations.why: An upload is not generated art, so Accept is refused and it fills no slot.

situations.name: chunks
situations.why: A derived prompt in chunks mode: the Chunks segment is refused as current, and an untouched clause’s Reset is refused.

situations.name: custom
situations.why: A whole prompt written by hand: Condense becomes Reconcile, the Custom segment is refused, and its box is drawn.

situations.name: agent
situations.why: A condensed prompt: the Chunks segment clears the agent part rather than the custom one.

situations.name: frozen
situations.why: A concept’s prompt was authored, so every segment, Condense and Save are refused with the reason.

situations.name: editing-a-clause
situations.why: A clause has its Replace box open, so the box is anchored beside the button that opened it.

situations.name: muted-clause
situations.why: A muted clause refuses Mute again and offers Reset.

situations.name: notes-clause
situations.why: A clause written as art notes: its origin button scrolls to the notes on this pane rather than opening another editor.

situations.name: with-refs
situations.why: A clause carries reference images, one of them drifted, so each is offered to open and to drop.

situations.name: no-scene
situations.why: Nothing is selected, so the bar offers + scene, Fit and Refresh and nothing else.

situations.name: scene
situations.why: A deletable scene is selected, so delete is offered with the check’s count as its tooltip.

situations.name: entry-scene
situations.why: The entry scene cannot be deleted, so delete is refused with the stack’s sentence.

situations.name: naming
situations.why: The naming row is open, so its two fields, Write it and Cancel stand in for + scene and delete.

situations.name: labelling
situations.why: A choice’s label box is open, so the box offers story.setChoice with the text typed after, and stands in for the label that opened it.

situations.name: cards
situations.why: Two cards are drawn while a shot of the first is selected, so pressing the second clears the shot and pressing the first keeps it; nothing reaches the second. The choice between them has a label that opens its box.

situations.name: empty
situations.why: Nothing has been said, so Compact is refused, and nothing is open, so Continue and Stop are refused.

situations.name: after-a-turn
situations.why: A turn has run, so Compact is offered with the context size and the budget label shows the spend.

situations.name: mid-turn
situations.why: A turn is in flight, so Stop is offered and Compact is refused until it ends.

situations.name: plan-proposed
situations.why: The agent proposed a plan, so its card offers Reject and Approve.

situations.name: confirming
situations.why: An always-confirm tool is waiting, so its card offers Deny and Allow, naming the tool.

situations.name: reading
situations.why: A saved conversation is open for reading, so Continue is offered and Compact is refused.

situations.name: reading-unresumable
situations.why: The open conversation was recorded before it could be continued, so Continue is refused with the reason.

situations.name: no-effort-knob
situations.why: The bound model has no reasoning-effort setting, so the effort menu is refused.

situations.name: idle
situations.why: Only the bar is drawn: the mode toggle, New…, Refresh and Close all.

situations.name: files-mode
situations.why: The tree is grouped by folder, so the toggle reads FILES and offers the other grouping.

situations.name: renaming
situations.why: A row holds the rename box, which commits doc.rename on the document it stands in.

situations.name: rows-claimant-hidden
situations.why: Only the tree is up, so a row that opens an editor opens it elsewhere; a heading and a stand-in expand.

situations.name: rows-claimant-visible
situations.why: Script and Asset are up, so a scene row and an asset row open here; the selected asset row expands instead.

situations.name: backlinks
situations.why: A character is picked, so the panel links its sheet, its art, and the scenes and shots it appears in.

situations.name: nothing-selected
situations.why: Nothing is selected and no slot is drawn, so the four selection buttons and Asset are refused before anything is weighed.

situations.name: nodes-selected
situations.why: Plain nodes are selected and weighed, so Delete, Duplicate and Group are offered and Ungroup is refused; the graph draws a slot, so Asset is offered.

situations.name: group-selected
situations.why: A group instance is selected and weighed, so Ungroup is offered.

situations.name: no-level
situations.why: Nodes are selected but the level on screen no longer resolves, so every button is refused with NO_LEVEL.

situations.name: no-task
situations.why: Nothing is selected, so only Refresh is drawn.

situations.name: task
situations.why: A task is on screen; its attempts are read-only, so Refresh is still the one control.

situations.name: blank
situations.why: The key box is empty, so Save key is refused until something is pasted; Test key is offered.

situations.name: typed
situations.why: A key has been pasted at project scope and the command accepts, so Save key is offered.

situations.name: mock
situations.why: The workspace runs with mock providers, so Test key is refused with the command’s sentence.

situations.name: no-links
situations.why: The guide names no pricing page for this vendor, so that link is refused; the verdicts are not in yet.

situations.name: start
situations.why: The story is at its first scene, so Back is refused with the reason.

situations.name: mid-story
situations.why: A scene has been played, so Back is offered.

situations.name: choice
situations.why: The scene ends in two choices, so the panel offers each branch by its label.

situations.name: scene-end
situations.why: The scene leads on to one more, so the panel offers Continue.

situations.name: clean
situations.why: The box matches the file, so Apply is refused with No changes; the box, reload and the image-model picker stay offered.

situations.name: dirty
situations.why: The box holds something the file does not, so Apply is offered.

situations.name: openrouter-model
situations.why: The file names an OpenRouter model, which the picker’s button shows as its label.

situations.name: no-project
situations.why: No project is open, so Apply, the box and the picker are refused.

situations.name: setup
situations.why: The setup card is up and the command accepts, so Start is offered with its cost as the tooltip.

situations.name: mock
situations.why: The workspace runs with mock providers, so Start is refused with the command’s sentence.

situations.name: open
situations.why: A conversation is open with source access granted, so that grant box is refused as already given.

situations.name: no-scene
situations.why: No scene is loaded, so only the bar is drawn: the scene picker and reload.

situations.name: scene
situations.why: A scene is on the page: its heading opens the move dialog, each line has a drag handle and opens a text box, the spoken line has a cue slot, the second line offers a split, and the structure buttons add a line, merge the next scene in, or continue to a new one.

situations.name: empty-scene
situations.why: A scene with no lines invites the first one and offers nothing to split or add to.

situations.name: editing-a-line
situations.why: One line’s box is open, so its box stands in for that line’s control.

situations.name: composing
situations.why: A composer is open under the last line, so its box offers the insert it would commit.

situations.name: with-frames
situations.why: Two frames were drawn from this scene, so the strip under the page opens each in the asset editor.

situations.name: picking-a-speaker
situations.why: One line’s cue picker is open, so that slot says what picking does.

situations.name: pending-merge
situations.why: A merge is pending, so the strip’s button offers story.mergeScene, Cancel closes it, and no split is offered.

situations.name: pending-split
situations.why: A split is pending, so the strip’s id field and button offer story.splitScene.

situations.name: pending-scene
situations.why: A new scene is pending, so the strip’s id and heading fields and its button offer story.newScene.

situations.name: none-open
situations.why: No skill is open, so Save and the text box are refused; reload and the hint’s agent button are always offered.

situations.name: open
situations.why: A skill is open and unchanged, so Save is refused with Nothing to save.

situations.name: open-dirty
situations.why: The open skill has changed, so Save is offered.

situations.name: no-prompt
situations.why: No project is open, so there is no prompt and Copy is refused.

situations.name: prompt
situations.why: A prompt of three sections has been read, so Copy is offered.

situations.name: no-gate
situations.why: No run is waiting at a gate, so only the bar is drawn: Tidy, Fit and Refresh.

situations.name: scoped
situations.why: The graph is narrowed to one picture’s work and the search box has found two slots, so the bar offers Overview and each hit offers its scope.

situations.name: gate-unasked
situations.why: A gate is pending and not yet asked about, so the button is offered live before the round trip.

situations.name: gate-with-candidates
situations.why: The check refuses the blank hash but candidates are on file, so the button stays live and the sentence goes to its tooltip.

situations.name: gate-without-candidates
situations.why: Nothing is on file to approve, so the button is refused with the command’s sentence.

situations.name: cards
situations.why: Two task cards are drawn: a shot names its scene and shot, a portrait names its character.

situations.name: idle
situations.why: Only the bar is drawn: Run, the three status ticks, Clear finished refused with nothing to clear, and Refresh.

situations.name: gate-pending
situations.why: A run is waiting on a portrait, so the gate bar offers approval for that character.

situations.name: cards
situations.why: Two cards are drawn: a shot that rendered a frame opens it elsewhere after the pick, a task that drew nothing only publishes. One is done, so Clear finished is offered.

situations.name: no-scene
situations.why: No scene is on screen, so + shot is refused and only the bar is drawn.

situations.name: decomposed
situations.why: The scene has shots, so + shot is offered and no door is drawn; each line has a gutter and opens a box, and the shot’s bracket selects it with a handle at each edge.

situations.name: editing-a-line
situations.why: One line’s box is open, so its box stands in for that line’s control.

situations.name: undecomposed-unasked
situations.why: The scene has no shots and the doors have not answered, so the bar and the lines are anchored and no door is.

situations.name: undecomposed-asked
situations.why: Both doors have answered: decompose is priced and offered, placing by hand is refused with the stack’s sentence.

situations.name: shot-selected
situations.why: A shot framing one of two characters is selected, so the strip offers the scene rows, the variant, the shot row with its remove button, the add select and the checkbox.

situations.name: shot-frames-nobody
situations.why: The selected shot frames nobody, so there is no shot row or remove button, and the checkbox is refused.

situations.name: none-open
situations.why: No page is open, so Save and the text box are refused; reload stays offered.

situations.name: open
situations.why: A page is open and unchanged, so Save is refused with Nothing to save.

situations.name: open-dirty
situations.why: The open page has changed, so Save is offered, and one picture drawn from it opens in the asset editor.

situations.name: following
situations.why: The pane follows the selected scene, so the toggle offers to hold it.

situations.name: pinned
situations.why: The pane is held on one scene, so the toggle offers to follow again.

situations.name: following
situations.why: The pane follows the selected scene, so the toggle offers to hold it.

situations.name: pinned
situations.why: The pane is held on one scene, so the toggle offers to follow again.

situations.name: following
situations.why: The pane follows the selected generation graph, so the toggle offers to hold it.

situations.name: pinned
situations.why: The pane is held on one generation graph, so the toggle offers to follow again.

situations.name: following
situations.why: The pane follows the selected task, so the toggle offers to hold it.

situations.name: pinned
situations.why: The pane is held on one task, so the toggle offers to follow again.

situations.name: following
situations.why: The pane follows the selected document, so the toggle offers to hold it.

situations.name: pinned
situations.why: The pane is held on one document, so the toggle offers to follow again.

situations.name: following
situations.why: The pane follows the selected asset, so the toggle offers to hold it.

situations.name: pinned
situations.why: The pane is held on one asset, so the toggle offers to follow again.

situations.name: every-kind
situations.why: One node of each kind the tree draws, so the menu’s coverage is total rather than a project’s.

situations.name: drawn
situations.why: The shot has a frame, so Open shot asset leaves for it in the Asset editor.

situations.name: undrawn
situations.why: The shot has no frame yet, so Open shot asset is refused with the strip’s sentence.

situations.name: page
situations.why: A drawn page of two panels gets the same menu as a frame: one asset, one image.

situations.name: drawn
situations.why: The shot covering the line has a frame, so Open shot asset leaves for it.

situations.name: undrawn
situations.why: The shot covering the line has no frame yet, so Open shot asset is refused saying so.

situations.name: uncovered
situations.why: No shot covers the line, which is a different refusal with a different next move.

situations.name: scene
situations.why: A written scene is offered its script, opened elsewhere so the canvas is never covered.

situations.name: stub
situations.why: A stub has no script, so the one act it has is writing the scene, as a form.

situations.name: nothing-saved
situations.why: No conversation has been saved, so the one row is refused and says why.

situations.name: two-saved
situations.why: Two conversations are saved and the second is open, so its row is marked.

situations.name: fresh
situations.why: Nothing has been opened before and no layout is saved, so Recent and Layout each hold one refused row.

situations.name: project
situations.why: Two projects are remembered, one of them open and refused; two layouts exist, one unusable; the page builder is installed; the agent is executing.

situations.name: running
situations.why: A pipeline run is in flight, so Run Pipeline is refused with the header’s sentence.

situations.name: no-pane
situations.why: No pane can be moved and the arrangement cannot be serialized, so both rows are refused.
